description: Machine-readable form of the §6 Master Mapping Table. Single source of truth for tests/conformance/spec/test_validation_mapping_table.py. Per ADR 0150 §4.2/§10, the schema's MasterTable const was demoted; the canonical 5-row byte-equality pin now lives at closed-core-5-rows-jcs.json (JCS RFC 8785). This developer-facing fixture mirrors the §6 prose for human readability and per-row predicate validation.
